about: Zamp provides digital employees that take ownership of entire finance and back-office functions end to end, involving people only when needed.
tone: Plain, warm and direct. Short sentences. Sounds like one thoughtful person writing to another.

offerings.name: Invoice processing and AP approvals
offerings.plain: Digital employees read invoices, match them and move them through approval.
problems: AP teams growing with invoice volume
buying_signals: Hiring AP analysts or AP clerks
Comments about slow close or manual invoice work
Fast growth in vendors or transactions
A new ERP or finance system
proof: Reduced Instacart's AP approval times from 2 weeks to 2 days, automating 80% of manual work
Processed 95%+ of Mindbody's invoices end-to-end, involving humans only when needed

offerings.name: Purchase request approvals
offerings.plain: Digital employees take purchase requests through approval.
problems: Purchase requests stuck waiting for approval
Procurement teams overloaded with routine requests
buying_signals: Comments about slow purchasing or procurement backlogs
proof: Automated 85% of Amgen's purchase requisitions through approval, cutting turnaround time 60%

offerings.name: Accounting close
offerings.plain: Digital employees take on the repeated work in the month-end close.
problems: The close depending on people working late
buying_signals: Preparing for an IPO or a stricter audit
An acquisition that adds new entities
proof: Eliminated 75% of human touchpoints in Block's accounting close process

offerings.name: Invoice audit
offerings.plain: Digital employees audit invoices quickly and at lower cost.
problems: High outsourcing cost for back-office checks
buying_signals: Outsourcing or BPO contracts in finance
proof: Reduced Uber Freight's invoice audit time from 1 day to 1 hour, at 30% lower cost than a BPO

offerings.name: Chargeback filing
offerings.plain: Digital employees file chargebacks quickly so deadlines are not missed.
buying_signals: Banks or card issuers launching new card products
proof: Filed chargebacks in under 10 minutes per case at Wio, with zero missed network deadlines

role_focus.lead_with: cost, control and not adding headcount
fewer errors, cleaner audits and a faster close

role_focus.ask: whether this matches their team's experience

cares_about: Getting routine work off the team's plate
default_role_focus.lead_with: routine work no longer needing people
